A '''resort satellite''' was one of many in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Gilatter VIII]] that was built during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. During a brief era when [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] artistic appreciation was the primary focus of wealthy families' holidays, patrons would visit the [[resort satellite]]s and marvel at Gilatter VIII's beauty. As tastes changed, the resort satellites closed down. The last to close shut down approximately 150 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], but in that year, it was temporarily resurrected.

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]], newly-elected [[Supreme Commander of the Confederation military]], lured his enemies in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] to the [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]]. They took the bait, and a [[Battle of Gilatter VIII|battle]] ensued. The Alliance believed that [[Confederation]] delegates would be aboard the satellite, but Phennir instead had actors play their roles.
